subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with detail contexts such as full verbose, heartbeat, or timed-out cron be fully suppressed, or should those detail warnings remain visible while only ordinary non-detail exec warnings are suppressed?
rationale: Current tests intentionally keep several detail-mode exec warnings visible, so automation cannot safely rewrite the policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Clarify Policy Before Merge
options.body: Decide the intended exec-like warning contract, then update the branch and tests to match that policy.

options.title: Preserve Detail Warnings
options.body: Keep heartbeat, cron, and full-verbose warnings visible and narrow the linked issue to the remaining non-detail warning leak.

options.title: Suppress All Exec-Like Warnings
options.body: Accept hiding those detail-mode warnings and require focused regression tests plus real behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Clarify Policy Before Merge
recommendation.body: Decide the intended exec-like warning contract, then update the branch and tests to match that policy.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has recent work in both the warning payload and tool-mutation surfaces that determine the policy boundary.
